messages:
jen: Huge thanks to @clara for sprinting over to pick up the stranded HDMI+power bundle and getting the cross-team demo back online — you saved the meeting! :raised_hands:
rory: Seconded. I literally watched Clara juggle three cables and a coffee. Legend move. :laughing:
clara: Happy to help! FYI I put the spare kit in the A/V cabinet labeled `AV-cable-kit-v2` and taped a quick checklist on the door.
emily: Nominate for "Team MVP"? I can toss a GIF in the #all-hands thread and add a little kazoo fanfare. :trophy: :confetti_ball:
nate: Also, quick ask: can we get a tiny budget line for replenishing extras (cables, dongles, batteries)? ops-bot, can you drop the usual vendor link?
ops-bot: FYI: Approved vendors list — https://vendors.internal/av-supplies. Order template created: `ORDER-AV-2026`. Request via #ops-requests.
jen: Thanks ops-bot. @nate please create the ticket and cc @clara for preferred specs.
emily: Putting in a formal kudos here: Clara — "Cable Whisperer". :medal_sports: Would anyone like to add a short note for the weekly roundup?
rory: +1 "Saved our demo and my dignity" :sweat_smile:
clara: Aw thanks everyone. No need for fluff, just happy the demo didn't turn into a Q&A about why slides exist. :coffee:
jen: OK voting time: do we want an A/V spare kit in every conference room? React with :+1: for yes, :-1: for no.
rory: :+1:
emily: :+1: (also cookies if implemented)
nate: :-1: (we'll have spare cables but not hidden treasure chests)
jen: Cool — majority yes. I'll open the procurement ticket and tag facilities. Thanks again, team — small moments like this keep things smooth.
